items.title: Try Sonnet for small and medium jobs
items.detail: Opus took 96% of Claude spend in the last 28 days. Your small and medium tasks cost a median $2.49 on Opus and $1.09 on Sonnet, and passed CI first time 86% and 100% of the time. Switch with /model sonnet for fixes and small features, and keep Opus for big or tricky work.

items.title: Keep sessions to one task each
items.detail: Each reply read 171k tokens on average in the last 7 days (237k the week before). Re-reading that context was 48% of Claude spend. Start a new session for each task, and /clear when you switch to something unrelated, so replies stop carrying old work.

items.title: Start fresh after a break instead of resuming
items.detail: 18 cache rebuilds cost $8.18 in the last 7 days (19 the week before). Once a session sits idle for an hour its cache expires, and the next reply pays to write the whole conversation again. After a long break, start a new session with a short summary, or run /compact before you step away.

items.title: Ask for tests on the tricky part up front
items.detail: 42 later commits changed files from 10 tasks shipped in the last 28 days, most after PR #166 (8). Follow-up fixes usually mean the first pass missed a case, so ask Claude to write a test for the risky part before it builds.

items.title: Claude spend down 66% on the week before
items.detail: $59 in the last 7 days, against $173. Busiest day: Wed 11 Nov, at $23.
